title: Platform Extraction V1.1 Modern Runtime Parity

preflight.note: Created from approved Platform Extraction V1 review before V1.1 runtime-parity implementation began. Base is public 8970368.

acceptance_criteria.text: Public runtime is based on the accepted modern CourseProgress, Classroom, Lecture, Instructor, Academic, and Labs semantics rather than a reduced second learning engine.
The public package contract is canonical, lossless for supported authored semantics, strictly validated, hierarchy-aware, and owned by the public schema artifact.
Public persistence unifies legacy state, package progress, Classroom, Lecture, Academic, and Labs data through the native store where available and a browser fallback, with backup compatibility.
A+, Network+, and Security+ adapters are truthful: no fabricated Labs, lectures, mastery, or assessment authority is claimed where public source does not support it.
Public and private privacy/ancestry gates pass, with no private authored content, evidence, paths, fixtures, screenshots, or personal-name additions in public history.
Public browser and runtime tests prove authoritative activity progression, lecture/session persistence, academic surfaces, truthful Labs behavior, backup roundtrip, and multi-course isolation.

source: Platform Extraction V1.1 TRUE MODERN RUNTIME EXTRACTION + LOSSLESS COURSE CONTRACT request.
